state_scope.geometry: retained serial warm-periodic2x2 host captures; one column per source
state_scope.optical_definition: retained Gamma8 Segelstein25C Planck-band diagnostic; actual host state fixed
state_scope.radius_coverage: discrete evaluated selected radii only; not the interval between them
state_scope.CF_and_seed: retained original CF, mask and seed; not an overlap/occurrence reference or seed ensemble

target_contract.layer_quantity: temperature-equivalent heating K/day using same native capacity; all59 layers retained
target_contract.scientific_claim: Accuracy of the bounded liquid-optics approximation at the named observables, conditional on unchanged gas/transport/CF/seed/capacity; not total-atmosphere absolute accuracy.
target_contract.component_reference: A qualified liquid-optics reference mapped through the same held transport/source is permitted for this component claim. A new independent RTE or Mie engine is not a newly added requirement.

acceptance.reason: The selected liquid-component application lacks an intended-use error allocation and qualification/uncertainty dossier for its optical reference. Current A/B/C differences support conditional sensitivity; they are not a total-atmosphere error budget.

error_budget.combination_rule: Only if all terms are certified bounds with matching domains: abs(candidate-reference)+U_num+U_ref+U_repr <= epsilon. No root-sum-square independence assumption. Unknowns never become zero.

two_unconverged_absorption_coefficients.reason: Neither diagnostic coefficients nor SW absorption accuracy are being adopted; two additional converged values would not resolve reference qualification or intended-use budget.
two_unconverged_absorption_coefficients.if_needed_later: Only SW11@22.125196um and SW12@21.5um: separate radius/spectral refinement, then examine weak-absorption computation; preserve the historical failure.

next_decision_evidence.single_dossier: A liquid-optics reference qualification/uncertainty and intended-use error-allocation dossier for the named conditional component claim.
required_fields: scientific intended use and epsilon authority
matching PSD/moments, RI/temperature, spectral weighting, source/boundary, occurrence
State independence from the production LUT and shared solver/data limitations accurately; do not demand a new independent kernel or double-count shared-code evidence.
numerical reference qualification including weak absorption when relevant
explicit route under original PHY-SIZE condition; no silent replacement of original criterion
